description: Stock Strata v0.2.10 with stock OMP 18.16.0; qwen3.8-flash-next-iq3_s on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 + NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090, native Windows, text only, 262,144-token context. Stock setup-derived thresholds and flags; no hardware qualification or inherited receipts. Stock pipeline windows pinned: --pipeline-windows 2. Stock PLE direct reads pinned: --ple-io direct (the PLE table stays on direct SSD reads instead of the engine's automatic RAM residency). Stock stage weight trim pinned: --trim-stage-weights (each card loads only its own layers' dense weights; needs the manual split point). Stock engine environment pinned: gdn_stack, sm86_table (config env, stock values). Stock engine 0.1.56 defaults: int8 prompt attention on these CUDA cards; tool-call recovery for declared tools is on by default (no tool_call_recovery key is written or pinned), alongside always-on quoted-call, missing-function-closer, lenient non-string JSON argument and stray-think-closer repairs; calls inside fenced or indented code stay text (Strata#4702, #4703) and tools the conversation already called count as declared (Strata#4663). The automatic expert cache keeps about 256 MiB more VRAM free (Strata#4474). With pinned batch slots, conversation parking keeps the shared prefix (Strata#4420). The pinned --ple-io direct reads replace automatic RAM PLE residency; the residency policy and its Strata#4518 lock release do not apply. The engine owns the FP16 weight-cache and all-experts-resident no-slot-loan defaults (STRATA_PF_W16_CACHE_MIB and STRATA_AUTO_NOBORROW are unpinned). Penalties count the reply (Strata#4590); Windows reports inherited low disk priority (Strata#4733); short arena RAM can fall back to file reads (Strata#4846), which start verification refuses. Stock drafting Auto keeps the MTP: --pipeline-windows. This profile pins stock's Linux GDN tensor-core prompt defaults; the engine's RTX 3090 (sm_86) defaults it skips on this mixed pair, Strata#3313 through the config's env. Eligible split prompts use layer-major prefill; the Ada card uses the new MMVQ row tables. Pipelined batch groups are the two-card default only with batch slots enabled; this profile keeps slots off. It separately pins --pipeline-windows 2. Stock OMP 18.16.0 selects replace editing for Qwen3.8; no edit-mode override is pinned. Stock GPU roles pinned: --gpu-roles 0=main,1=helper (Main GPU 0 last). Stock manual layer split pinned: --layer-split 24.
